o1: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in Wnt signaling pathway; regulating spindle positioning; engulfment of apoptotic cell; and left/right axis specification. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is expressed in distal tip cell; germ line; seam cell; and sperm. Is part of the canonical Wnt signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; bipolar disorder; oral squamous cell carcinoma; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to human GSK3A (glycogen synthase kinase 3 alpha) and GSK3B (glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta).
